title: 第一卷 第17章 出发秘境第一卷 第18章 她这辈子没这么痛过
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
功法散尽重修对别人而言或许糟糕至极。
但对洛还真而言，未尝不是一件好事。她是一块完美的玉石，现在有了被更尽善尽美雕琢的机会。
洛还真为了一口吃的，拿出了百分百的努力。
直到她一拳让整个瀑布水流都悬止截断了一瞬，两个呼吸之后才重新恢复流动，她顿时激动不已！
“本尊做到辣！！”
洛还真像个兔子一般从水中冲了出来，两条小腿哒哒哒，爬上石头就开始吃。
云爻嘴角微微翘起一个弧度，他不动声色地掐诀，一阵温柔带着哄哄热气的风出现，帮小孩身上的衣裳烘干。
洛还真吃东西的动作顿了顿。
她抬起头，腮帮子鼓鼓地说：“师尊，真真不怕，真真湿漉漉的也不生病！不浪费灵力，灵力要省着，不然打架的时候会不够用！”
说完，还擦了下嘴嘴，用手自豪地拍拍小胸脯。
她就很会节省灵力！
而听见这话，云爻却怔住了。
一想到洛还真像个没人要的小可怜，破破烂烂独自一人在万魔窟求生，日晒雨淋衣服湿漉漉也不敢烘干，就因为害怕魔物袭击时灵力不够用。
而衡阳子师徒六人却在宗门里抱着个假货千娇百宠地养着，云爻脸上的笑容就淡了下去，一阵心疼。
他青墨色的瞳眸注视着洛还真，一字一句道：“不会的，师尊想这样做。”
洛还真一副无奈的样子，叹气道：“好吧。”
不过嘴角却像是压不住一样，翘起一个小小的弧。
洛还真吃东西很认真，就连掉到地上的渣渣，都会一点点捡起来吃干净。
吃过苦的孩子，不浪费丁点的食物。
衣裳干了，云爻收起法诀，看着洛还真突然道：“快要突破了？”

洛还真闻言小脑袋点了点，“嗯。”
她突破是这样的。
不用怎么修炼，境界会自己提升起来。
云爻沉吟片刻，缓缓道：“真真，试着压制一下境界，两个月后再突破。”
洛还真一脸茫然：“如何压制？”
云爻道：“坐好，师尊教你，这样……”
修士的基础打得越扎实，未来的路才能走的越远。
洛还真必定成仙。
但是云爻希望她能走得远一点，再远一点，她这般天资，理应站上仙路尽头的最高峰。
有了云爻教导，接下来洛还真果然没再来过学宫。
不过她人不在学宫，学宫中却处处流传着她的传说。
尤其是在覃长老十日后告知学宫弟子《困魔通史》有误，需进行修正，所有相关课程暂停半月之后，学宫中洛还真名字出现的频率更高了。
“妈耶……我不敢想她当时说‘全都会’是不是也是真话了。”
“天才就是天才，恐怖如斯！”
“佩服这两个字我已经说腻了……一直觉得苏师妹已算聪颖，但真比较起来……”
话没说完，但是所有人都知道话中意思：洛师妹落入万魔窟太早，他们未能目睹幼年天才是何等风采，现在真假一对比，苏师妹确实差得太远。
听见这些话，苏明月眼眶通红，手指甲掐进掌心肉里，心里的不甘几乎溢出来。
又到了一月一次去找丹红长老浸泡药浴滋养身体的日子。
三师兄赵青也在，他主修丹道，没有外出的日子他偶尔会随丹红长老学习。
content_en:
It may be extremely bad for others to have their skills dissipated and be re-cultivated.
But for Luo Huanzhen, it might not be a bad thing. She is a perfect piece of jade, and now she has the opportunity to be carved even more perfectly.
Luo really tried his best to get a bite to eat.
It wasn't until she punched that the entire waterfall flow stopped for a moment. It took two breaths before it resumed flowing. She was suddenly excited!
“I’ll make it spicy!!”
Luo really rushed out of the water like a rabbit, with his little legs clicking, he climbed up the stone and started eating.
The corners of Yun Yao's mouth raised a slight arc, and he silently kneaded the hand, and a gentle and warm wind appeared to help dry the children's clothes.
Luo Huanzhen paused while eating.
She raised her head and said with bulging cheeks: "Master, I'm really not afraid, I'm really not sick even when I'm wet! Don't waste your spiritual energy, save your spiritual energy, otherwise it won't be enough during a fight!"
After saying that, he wiped his mouth and proudly patted his chest with his hands.
She is very good at saving spiritual energy!
But hearing this, Yun Yao was stunned.
When I think of Luo, he really looks like a little pitiful nobody. He is in tatters and surviving alone in the Ten Thousand Demons Cave. He is exposed to the sun and rain and his clothes are wet but he dare not dry them because he is afraid that he will not have enough spiritual power when the monsters attack.
However, the six masters and disciples of Hengyangzi were holding the fake in their arms and raising it lovingly. The smile on Yun Yao's face faded, and she felt heartbroken.
He stared at Luo Huanzhen with his green eyes and said word by word: "No, Master wants to do this."
Luo Huan really looked helpless and sighed: "Okay."
However, the corners of his mouth turned up in a small arc, as if he couldn't hold it back.
Luo is really serious about eating. Even the dregs that fall on the ground will be picked up and eaten bit by bit.
A child who has endured hardship will not waste any food.
After the clothes were dry, Yun Yao put away the magic formula, looked at Luo Huanzhen and said suddenly: "Are you about to break through?"
Luo Huanzhen nodded his head when he heard this, "Yeah."
This is her breakthrough.
You don’t need to practice much, your realm will improve on its own.
Yun Yao pondered for a moment and said slowly: "Zhenzhen, try to suppress the realm and break through in two months."
Luo Huazhen looked confused: "How to suppress it?"
Yun Yao said: "Sit tight, Master will teach you, like this..."
The more solid a monk's foundation is, the further he can go in the future.
Luo Huan really will become an immortal.
But Yun Yao hopes that she can go a little further, and a little further. With her talent, she should stand on the highest peak at the end of the immortal road.
With Yun Yao's guidance, Luo Huanzhen never came to the academy again.
However, she was not in the academy, but her legend was spread everywhere in the academy.
Especially after Elder Qin informed the disciples of the academy ten days later that the "General History of Trapped Demons" was wrong and needed to be corrected, and all related courses were suspended for half a month, Luo Huanzhen's name appeared more frequently in the academy.
"Oh my god...I don't dare to think if she was telling the truth when she said 'all cities'."
"A genius is a genius, so terrifying!"
"I'm tired of saying admiration... I've always thought that Junior Sister Su is smart, but in comparison..."
The words were not finished, but everyone knew what they meant: Junior Sister Luo fell into the Cave of Ten Thousand Demons too early, and they failed to see how graceful a young genius was. Now when comparing the true and false, Junior Sister Su is indeed far behind.
Hearing these words, Su Mingyue's eyes turned red, her fingernails dug into the flesh of her palms, and the unwillingness in her heart almost overflowed.
It's time to go to Elder Danhong once a month to take a medicinal bath to nourish the body.
Third senior brother Zhao Qing is also there. He majors in Alchemy. On days when he doesn't go out, he occasionally studies with Elder Danhong.
